تباكيت (form VI)
# تَبَاكَيْتُ (tabākaytu) /ta.baː.kaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَبَاكَى (tabākā)
# تَبَاكَيْتَ (tabākayta) /ta.baː.kaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَبَاكَى (tabākā)
# تَبَاكَيْتِ (tabākayti) /ta.baː.kaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَبَاكَى (tabākā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
